title: Reporting Cartilage Lesions
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: State the depth as partial or full thickness rather than by grade alone.
State the area and the compartment, since a contained lesion differs from diffuse loss.
Report the bone beneath, because marrow change often marks a lesion the surface does not.
Report whether the cartilage is separated from the bone with the surface intact.
Say that the report should state which sequences the assessment rests on.
The grade on the scan and the grade at arthroscopy disagree, so the operative plan should carry both and the consent should say so.
